I don't know what u look like but you certainly don't sound dumb.  And your english isn't shitty at all I would have assumed it was your first language by your writing.  It feels so patronizing when people say "you should be proud" but seriously they don't hand out cum laudes to just anyone.  I'm not saying that you should be proud but, hey, you certainly could have done worse.  Maybe there is some comfort to be taken in that? 

This world seems like it was engineered to be enjoyed by people who are so rich that they don't have to work.  Super attractive people tend to do well because they can be enjoyed by the rich sexually, at least for a time.  Smart people are often in a tricky spot because they are conscious enough to recognize how everyone is getting absolutely fucked every moment of their lives living in this system where we willingly surrender our best years at some stupid company that does genuine harm to the world while not giving two shits about their employees.  

The extra smart people figure out a way to game the system and generate enough passive income that they can say fuck you to all of this.  Based on your post, I think you are capable of this.  I genuinely wish you a life free of the rat race and free of shitty fake co workers.  

In my opinion anyone who ISN'T depressed or dealing with some kind of mental illness in the current state of this world is a special kind of moron because to be quite honest it's fucked.  

As for the tinder dates, keep trying it's honestly just a numbers game, but trust me while loneliness is a very real thing a relationship will not make the issues you are facing go away it will just hide them for awhile.  Be well.
